q1: SELECT b1.name AS bar1, b2.name AS bar2 FROM bar AS b1, bar AS b2 WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT s1.beer FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND s2.beer = s1.beer)) AND EXISTS(SELECT s2.beer FROM serves AS s2 WHERE s2.bar = b2.name AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s1 WHERE s1.bar = b1.name AND s1.beer = s2.beer))
q2: SELECT s1.bar AS bar1, s2.bar AS bar2 FROM serves AS s1 JOIN serves AS s2 ON s1.beer = s2.beer AND s1.bar <> s2.bar WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM serves AS s WHERE s.bar = s2.bar AND NOT s.beer IN (SELECT beer FROM serves WHERE bar = s1.bar))

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they are checking for different conditions related to the beers served by bars. Q1 is looking for bars that serve beers which no other bar serves, and also for bars that serve beers which at least one other bar does not serve. Q2, on the other hand, is looking for pairs of bars that serve the same beer, where at least one bar serves the beer and the other does not.
